text: {"lessons":["A large gain in Stock A felt rewarding to lock in, but the sale should be based on its future prospects and portfolio balance—not the pleasure of realizing a gain.","Selling only part of a position can preserve exposure while reducing concentration; I should consider position size rather than making all-or-nothing decisions.","The account value fell after my sale, but that does not show the sale was wrong: random price moves make outcomes a poor substitute for a sound decision process."]}
